parameters.text:
The rest of the day goes by in a blur. Classes begin and end, lunch happens at some point, you think, and suddenly it is time to make your way back home. 

No one called you names today, which you found a nice change of pace, but no one said anything else to you either. No one apologised. No one sat next to you. No one asked you how you were doing or what you did during the weekend. Even Stan kept his distance, despite what happened yesterday.

It was as if you did not exist for most of the day, and it felt bad. Not as bad as being called names, getting shoved, or having people laugh at you, sure, but far from the ideal outcome you wanted.
